meaning: Prepare complete source-bound verification inputs for one registered Python whole-project plan, without substituting inventory checks for native, semantic or formal execution.
identity: Require a registered compiled graph and registered Python plan with matching full compiled certificate and source manifest. Validate graph obligations and the finite graph refinement certificate. Serialized evidence can be compared with reconstructed inputs but cannot revive a checked plan.
coverage: Account for every generated artifact as a resolved Python module, every graph node as a qualified native owner, all native relative imports and package initializers, each node import-closure view, exact contracts, authored compilation selection and every semantic relationship. Record actual project denominators; the release qualification still covers all13 metatypes and39 language cells.
separation: Bind native artifact hashes and module surfaces once, not repeated source bytes for each node. Preparing evidence runs no native interpreter, imports no generated Python, writes no files, and supplies no execution results. Required checks remain not-executed.
scope_correction: The accepted support-matrix.json row domainspec.project-composition/v1 explicitly has no Python target. The R10/PCR-08 requirement is native realization of all13 metatypes and their domain composition, not a new Python HTTP application target or a Node/Python bridge. Earlier request210/211 staging text overstated that endpoint requirement. Existing node-http/rust-http input checks and explicit Python rejection remain unchanged. Domain relationships, compound multi-feature behavior and public verification are not excluded.
remaining: A separate executor must actually perform the required checks, with per-node positive/negative semantic controls and language-specific observations, before stronger verification can pass. This projection neither completes R10 nor admits, releases or changes CLI defaults.
